sample_scope: Bounded embodied-AI campus test loop covering geofence, supervision, accessibility, privacy, incident response and rollback.

sampling.method: Use versioned route segments and fixed observation windows; record exposure, interventions, near misses, accessibility obstruction, geofence events, overrides and data deletion/retention actions.
sampling.representativeness_limit: A bounded desk or campus test does not establish public-space readiness.

test_controls.non_ai_alternative: ordinary pedestrian circulation and human-led operation remain available
test_controls.continue_condition: Verified geofence, supervised operation, accessible movement, authorized minimal data use, reliable live stop and no unresolved serious incident.
test_controls.pause_condition: Missing baseline, geofence breach, supervision loss, near miss, accessibility obstruction, unauthorized data handling, unexplained output or unresolved complaint.
test_controls.exit_condition: Disable the test, remove temporary controls, restore ordinary circulation, close data access, execute retention/deletion decision and archive the record.
test_controls.public_disclosure: Publish method and version, aggregate exposure, failures, overrides, incidents, corrections, retention/deletion actions and unresolved limits without exposing personal data.

cost_estimation.method: Build a versioned bill of equipment, software, network, staff hours, supervision, safety barriers, accessibility support, insurance, review, data governance, removal and restoration; apply dated cited unit rates only after the test boundary is verified.

maintenance_cycle: pre-run hardware, geofence, stop and route check
per-run live supervision and log review
post-run incident, override and data-action review
scheduled model, software, sensor and security review

emergency_escalation.action: Live supervisor stops the system, secures the loop, restores ordinary circulation, records the event and notifies accountable and reviewer roles.
emergency_escalation.restart_authority: accountable safety owner and data controller after documented review

exit_acceptance: incident and complaint routes closed or transferred
claim_boundary: This is a participant-authored test and handoff method. It does not evidence site access, data permission, measured performance, cost, deployment, procurement, operator commitment or approval.
